name: Tiny Restorations Prologue
summary:
Step into a quiet garage where unfinished projects and family memories wait to be restored. In this hands-on VR experience, you assemble, repair, and clean a series of objects owned by your grandparents from small household builds to larger, more meaningful creations. Each completed task unlocks new tools, hidden parts, and personal memories told through photos and voicemails, slowly revealing a story about time, intention, and the things we mean to finish.
